exposure.needed: whether any tooling lists Kubernetes events for Pod restarts using a field-selector on regardingObject that names the Pod

consequence.statement: Kubernetes events for Pod restarts no longer have the Pod as the regardingObject, so event listings that use a regardingObject field-selector naming the Pod will no longer match these events.
consequence.remediation: Update any regardingObject field-selector used for listing these events so that it specifies the Kafka resource instead of the Pod.

assertion.statement: In Strimzi 0.46.0, the regardingObject on Kubernetes events for Pod restarts is no longer the Pod, so a regardingObject field-selector used to list these events must specify the Kafka resource instead.
